sources.title: [2510.07077] Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics: A Review ...
sources.snippet: Amid growing efforts to leverage advances in large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) for robotics, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently gained significant attention. By unifying vision, language, and action data at scale, which have traditionally been studied separately, VLA models aim to learn policies that generalise across diverse tasks, objects ...

sources.title: Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics: A Review Towards Real-World ...
sources.snippet: Researchers from The University of Tokyo, Oxford, and The University of Texas at Austin present a comprehensive, full-stack review of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotics, systematizing their evolution, architectures, training strategies, and real-world application challenges. The review aims to standardize understanding and guide the development of generalist robotic systems.

sources.snippet: A Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model is a system that takes visual observations and natural language instructions as required inputs and may incorporate additional sensory modalities.
